verdict.rationale: Activepieces has a publishing workflow with review gates (PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS permission) and staged rollout so changes don't disrupt live flows, which covers some review/approval aspects, but there's no documented version history browsing, diffing, or explicit rollback-to-previous-version capability. missing for 10: version history/diff view, explicit rollback UI or API, independent confirmation that rollback works as described.
